title: Rapidfire: webhook incident review

sentences.speaker: Diego Fuentes
sentences.text: Three job-complete webhooks never arrived last month. Drivers called us to ask where their instructions were.

sentences.speaker: Sam Ito
sentences.text: Failed webhooks aren't retried and there is no delivery log.

sentences.speaker: Diego Fuentes
sentences.text: We need retries with backoff, signed payloads, and a log we can search.

sentences.speaker: Marcus Hale
sentences.text: Understood. What deadline are we talking about?

sentences.speaker: Diego Fuentes
sentences.text: Our renewal terms say webhook delivery guarantees by the end of March, or we credit a quarter.

sentences.speaker: Marcus Hale
sentences.text: I'll flag the thirty-first of March internally.

summary: Rapidfire's renewal requires webhook retries, signing and delivery logs by 31 Mar 2027 or a quarter credit applies.
action_items: Marcus to flag 31 Mar 2027 webhook date to engineering
Sam to write webhook reliability spec
